comparison.objective: Sort four M8 and four M4 bolts into separate organizer compartments.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated fingertip pinch pickup, size discrimination, and bin placement.
comparison.success_condition: All M8 bolts are in the left compartment and all M4 bolts in the right; loss and containment thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Shared small-object recovery and deposit are generic primitives; sorting intact bolts does not test impact fracture, insert retention, or extraction of fragments from a shell.
